resources.string: Image downloads support Instagram and TikTok posts. Choose Auto or Video for video links.
Use List downloads → Instagram accounts for profile links.
Also delete files and related history
Download folder / platform / Images or Videos. Private files use .Seal.
Image tiers: short side x long side, comma separated
H265, VP9, AV1 ratios to H264 (0–1)

Images use both dimensions regardless of orientation. Videos use the highest tier satisfying original resolution and average file MB/s, adjusted for codec and FPS (48fps and above use the 60fps column). Unknown codec or FPS and files below the minimum stay in the base folder. These are estimates from total file size including audio. Existing files change only when reclassified.
